title: An entropy-adjusted invariant likelihood for incidental parameters
abstract: arXiv:2611.31707v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Incidental parameters can make maximum likelihood inconsistent in short panels. When they act through a known translation group, integration with respect to Haar measure eliminates them exactly and gives an invariant likelihood, whose score is shown to be the conditional expectation, given the maximal invariant, of the Neyman-orthogonalised score of every order. Under interactive fixed effects the orbit is an unknown factor space, and the invariant score for it has a drift equal to minus the derivative of the entropy of the retained contrasts. An entropy adjustment removes this drift and, at the true structural parameter, identifies the factor space uniquely when the loadings span it. translated_title: 一种针对伴随参数的熵调整不变似然
translated_abstract: 伴随参数会导致最大似然估计在短面板数据中不一致。当这些参数通过一个已知的平移群起作用时，关于哈尔测度进行积分可以完全消除它们，从而得到一个不变似然，并且可以证明该不变似然的得分是各阶Neyman正交化得分在给定最大不变量下的条件期望。在交互固定效应的情形下，轨道是一个未知的因子空间，其对应的不变得分包含一个漂移项，该漂移项等于保留对比的熵的导数的负值。熵调整消除了这一漂移，并且在真实结构参数处，当载荷张成该因子空间时，能够唯一地识别因子空间。调整后的估计方程是单一准则的梯度，当且仅当熵可以分解为一个轨道项和一个误差律项时成立，例如在尺度族和椭圆分布族中就是如此；此时一致性由一个设计条件推导得出，而在一般情况下则需要……（摘要截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种熵调整的不变似然方法，通过哈尔测度积分消除短面板中的伴随参数，并用熵调整修正交互固定效应下不变得分的漂移，从而在真实参数处唯一识别因子空间并保证估计量的一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an entropy-adjusted invariant likelihood that eliminates incidental parameters via Haar measure integration and corrects the drift of the invariant score under interactive fixed effects, uniquely identifying the factor space and ensuring estimator consistency.
